title: Good
altText: Stunning collaborative graffiti mural by Mr Blob, Moe, and Korvo, featuring a shiny golden Buddha character sitting inside a floating manta ray next to a surreal colorful bird and wildstyle lettering.
description: Painted with Moe and Korvo for the RestArt Urban Festival in Imola, this collaborative wall gathers symbols of fortune and serenity around a laughing golden Buddha, who cradles a glowing heart while riding a floating manta ray. A surreal long-beaked bird, a monocled golden bee and a glowing four-leaf clover complete the scene, set against wildstyle lettering on a dark background.
